title: Page 3
content_zh:
屋子里，童悠悠听到动静，惊喜的迎到门口，却被梁浩海一把推了回去，埋怨道——
“夜里风凉，你出来做什么？”
童悠悠脸红，赶紧去穿了一件外衫。
两人坐在桌前，梁浩海拆开油纸包，拧下一只大鸡腿就递给她，“饿了吧，今晚先吃这个，我忙得很，只来得及给你张罗这样的晚饭。”
“谢谢。”童悠悠接过，方才还不觉得如何，这会儿肚里的馋虫已闹开了。
梁浩海见她一口一口吃得秀气，就抬手给她倒茶，结果茶壶里空空如也，根本没有水。
他恼得骂开了，“这些混账，放在老子跟前，一鞭子抽死几个！按理说，你爹也是进士出身，读了一肚子圣贤书，怎么这么狗屁不通！不孝敬老娘就罢了，怎么对亲闺女也是不闻不问啊！”
他还想再说，童悠悠已经低下头，泪水一滴一滴落在桌子上，惊得他差点儿跳起来。
自从他们相识，无论是什么险境，他也没见这姑娘掉过眼泪啊，如今却泪落如雨，简直就是打在他心上，烫的他想发狂。
“你别哭啊，有委屈，你就说，别管是谁，我都砍了他的脑袋给你出气。你不知道，我如今可是大红人，不知道多少人求我高抬贵手呢！”
他一着急，就胡乱说了一堆，听得童悠悠想哭也哭不下去，只能抹了眼泪，瞪了他一记。
“我没事，就是……就是替我娘不值得。虽然她过世时我还小，但我记得她很温柔，抱着我哭了很多次。我原本以为能让我娘倾心的男人总有几分过人之处，没想到……童老爷只是童老爷。”
她这话说得古怪，但梁浩海却是听明白了。
童老爷就是童老爷，不是她爹，也就是她以后不再执着这份亲情了。
这倒是好事，否则对这样的父亲心软，说不定要怎么伤心，还要惹来多少麻烦呢！
“你想开了就好，这两年只管关门好好哄自己高兴，时日一到，我就来提亲。等你嫁到我家里，立刻当家做主，别说旁人，就是我全听你的，你让我杀鸡，我绝对不撵狗！”
“胡说什么！”童悠悠被他逗得笑了起来，低着头赶紧啃鸡腿，掩下眼底的一抹甜蜜。
两人说了几句闲话，毕竟梁浩海是趁暗夜偷偷前来，不好多作停留，万一被人发现，不用童夫人下手，童悠悠就能被口舌害死。
童悠悠送他到了廊檐下。
他飞快地抱了她一下，嘱咐道：“坚持一晚，明日徐家就会送东西过来，我给你准备了很多，若是还有什么不周全的，你就列个单子给虎妞，她知道怎么送给我。”

“好。”童悠悠重重点头，同样嘱咐道：“我不知道你的差事如何了，但你要小心，别像在台州府门前那样受伤。”
“放心吧。”梁浩海应下，抬手同虎妞招招手。
师徒两人就隐进了黑暗的角落里……
当晚，童老爷没有回来，整个童府鸦雀无声，奴仆们连走路都恨不得扛着腿，生怕发出了什么响动，惹得主母动怒，再拿他们出心中怒气。
守夜的婆子私下凑在一起，低声说起都道：“这几日咱们也别赌钱了，还是小心一些，否则被抓到，少不了皮开肉绽。夫人正憋了一口气，咱们可别自个儿撞上去。”
“放心，你不说，我们也想叮咛大伙呢。还有大小姐那里也要当心，被逮到毛病怕是比夫人打得更狠。”
“哼，什么大小姐，平日耀武扬威，整个府邸她说了算。可如今显出原形了，真正的嫡出大小姐回来了，她啊，变成二小姐了。”
有婆子幸灾乐祸，忍不住嘲讽道：“这是老夫人过世了，若是老夫人同大小姐一起回来，那就热闹了。”
“行了，我瞧着这回来的大小姐看着温温柔柔，但也不像是好欺负的，这府里还有得闹，咱们都老实看戏，别被卷进去就不错了。”
“对，我们就是看戏。”
“不过，听说今日去给大小姐拾掇院子的人说了，大小姐打赏很是丰厚，惹得我心里痒痒的。你们说大小姐是不是带了不少银子？不是说刘福把台州老家卖得差不多都空了吗，那银子应该在刘福手里，难道银子最后落在了大小姐手里？”
这些婆子私下琢磨着。
而上房里，童夫人翻来覆去睡不着觉，也没断了折磨童悠怱的打算。
这些年，她借口京都花费大，从来没给台州送过银钱，反倒撺掇老爷不时写信回去要一些银两。她算计着，婆母手里就算有些家底，应该也不多了。
但无论多少，那都是她的银钱，被一个死丫头攥在手里，她就感到心疼，哪里都不舒服。只是，刘福听了她的吩咐对童悠悠下毒手，这把柄被抓着，徐家又像极维护死丫头的样子，这会的她不敢轻易动手，只能先忍着，以后慢慢再谋算。
心中不停打算，她好不容易才睡着，也已经是半夜。
好似合上眼睛没多久，就有贴身伺候的婆子上前禀告——
“夫人该起了，大小姐该去女学，一会儿就来请安了。”
童夫人忍着太阳穴的抽痛，黑着脸起身，寻事骂了端水的丫鬟，这才觉得心里这口气顺了一些。
第十三章 家当全给她(1)

很快，童芊芊来请安，母女俩一起坐下吃饭。
童夫人瞧着闺女换了一身素色的衣裙，头上也只有银钗，自觉闺女懂事了，不禁露出了笑模样，她刚要夸赞女儿几句，就有二门的婆子来报——
“夫人，徐夫人又来了，还带了好几辆马车和很多人手。”
“什么？”童夫人皱着眉，有些恼了，“这徐家到底被那个死丫头灌了什么迷汤，昨日大张旗鼓上门就罢了，今日又来，难道还怕我吃了那个死丫头不成！”
她嘴里骂着，可到底不敢不接待，于是匆匆拾掇一下，赶去二门。
童芊芊感到好奇，顾不得上学，跟在后边，也去看个究竟。
很快，徐家的马车就进了童家大门，停在二门前。只不过马车实在太多，只有五辆进来，另外还有五辆在大门外。
徐夫人下了马车，身边还跟了个七八岁的小姑娘，娘俩的衣衫首饰不算华丽，毕竟童家还在孝期，但娘俩眉眼间的正气和端庄，却无时无刻不在同众人昭告，徐家身为御史之家的正直门风。别说五品郎中，就是一品大员也小看不得。
童家的奴仆都低着头，很是谦恭。
童夫人赶紧扬起笑脸，上前招呼，“哎呀，王姊姊，您怎么来了，可是我们昨日有什么做得不周到之处？”
徐夫人淡淡一笑，回礼道：“妹妹可是谁都知道的心善懂礼，怎么会有不周到之处？只不过是我家老嫂子惦记悠悠这个闺女刚刚回到家，怕悠悠住不惯，再加上我家的小丫头也想念她的悠悠姊姊，闹着要我早些过来，我没办法，才把悠悠这几日在家里的用物全送来了，还添了一些小东西。希望妹妹别误会，你虽然是继母，定然会待悠悠好的，我们不过是胡乱担心罢了。”
“不敢，不敢，王姊姊和大夫人这般疼爱我们悠悠，也是悠悠的福气。”童夫人心里骂个不停，表面上说话却依旧客气。
“那好，妹妹，让人把东西搬去悠悠的院子吧。这些东西，我都列了单子，一会儿给悠悠一份，我这里也留了一份，不怕奴仆们弄乱或者抬丢了。”
content_en:
In the house, Tong Youyou heard the noise and came to the door in surprise, but was pushed back by Liang Haohai, complaining——
"It's cold at night, what are you doing out here?"
Tong Youyou blushed and quickly put on a coat.
The two of them sat at the table. Liang Haohai opened the oil paper package, unscrewed a large chicken leg and handed it to her, "You are hungry, let's eat this first tonight. I am very busy and I only have time to arrange such a dinner for you."
"Thank you." Tong Youyou took it. She didn't think anything of it just now, but now she was full of greed.
Seeing how delicately she was eating, Liang Haohai raised his hand to pour her tea, but the teapot was empty and there was no water at all.
He was so angry that he cursed, "Put these bastards in front of me and whip a few of them to death! It stands to reason that your father was also a Jinshi and read a lot of books about saints and sages. How come you are so unreasonable! It's just that you are not filial to my mother, but you are indifferent to your own daughter!"
He wanted to say something more, but Tong Youyou had already lowered his head, tears falling on the table drop by drop, and he was so shocked that he almost jumped up.
Ever since they met, he had never seen this girl shed tears no matter what the danger was. But now she was crying like rain. It was like hitting his heart and making him want to go crazy.
"Don't cry. If you feel wronged, just say, no matter who it is, I will chop off his head to vent your anger. You don't know, I am a famous person now, and I don't know how many people beg me to show my favor!"
When he was anxious, he talked a lot of nonsense, which made Tong Youyou want to cry but couldn't stop crying. She could only wipe her tears and glare at him.
"I'm fine, it's just...it's just not worth it to replace my mother. Although I was still young when she passed away, I remember she was very gentle and hugged me and cried many times. I originally thought that the man who can make my mother fall in love always has something extraordinary, but I didn't expect...Master Tong is just Master Tong."
What she said was strange, but Liang Haohai understood it.
Master Tong is Master Tong, not her father, which means she will no longer cling to this family relationship.
This is a good thing, otherwise being soft-hearted to such a father might lead to heartache and trouble!
"It's fine if you want to. Just close the door and make yourself happy for the past two years. When the time comes, I will come to propose marriage. When you marry into my family, you will immediately be the master of the family. Don't talk about others. I will listen to you. If you ask me to kill the chicken, I will never chase the dog!"
"What nonsense!" Tong Youyou was amused by him and laughed. She lowered her head and ate the chicken leg quickly, hiding the sweetness in her eyes.
The two chatted a few words. After all, Liang Haohai came secretly in the dark night and could not stay too long. If someone discovered him, Tong Youyou would be killed by words without Mrs. Tong taking action.
Tong Youyou sent him to the eaves of the corridor.
He hugged her quickly and told her: "Hold on for one night, and the Xu family will send you something tomorrow. I have prepared a lot for you. If there is anything missing, just make a list for Huniu. She knows how to give it to me."
"Okay." Tong Youyou nodded heavily and also gave instructions: "I don't know how your errand is going, but you have to be careful not to get hurt like you did in front of Taizhou Mansion."
"Don't worry." Liang Haohai responded and raised his hand to wave to Huniu.
The master and apprentice hid in a dark corner...
That night, Master Tong did not come back, and the entire Tong Mansion was silent. The slaves even wanted to carry their legs while walking, for fear that they would make some noise and make the mistress angry, and then take out her anger on them.
The women who were watching the night gathered together in private and whispered: "Let's not gamble these days. We should be more careful, otherwise we will be caught and our skin will be torn to pieces. Madam is holding her breath, let's not run into it ourselves."
"Don't worry, if you don't say anything, we also want to give everyone a warning. We also need to be careful with the eldest lady. If you are caught doing something wrong, you may be beaten harder than the madam."
"Hmph, what eldest lady, you usually show off your strength?She has the final say in the whole mansion. But now her true colors are revealed, the real eldest daughter is back, and she has become the second daughter. "
A woman gloated over the misfortune and couldn't help but taunted: "The old lady has passed away. It would be lively if the old lady came back with the eldest lady. "
"Okay, I see that the eldest lady who has come back looks gentle and gentle, but she doesn't seem to be easy to bully. There is still trouble in this house. Let's just watch the show honestly and don't get involved. It's good. "
"Yes, we are just watching a show. "
"However, I heard that the people who went to clean up the yard for the eldest lady today said that the eldest lady's reward was very generous, which made me feel itchy. Do you think the eldest lady brought a lot of money? Didn't it mean that Liu Fu sold his hometown in Taizhou almost empty? The money should be in Liu Fu's hands. Did it end up in the hands of the eldest lady? "
These women were thinking about it privately.
In the upper room, Mrs. Tong tossed and turned, unable to sleep, and did not give up her plan to torture Tong Youchang.
Over the years, she had never sent any money to Taizhou on the pretext that Kyoto was very expensive. Instead, she encouraged the master to write letters back from time to time to ask for some money. She calculated that even if her mother-in-law had some wealth, she probably wouldn't have much left.
But no matter how much it was, it was her money. Being held in the hands of a dead girl made her feel distressed and uncomfortable everywhere. However, Liu Fu listened to her instructions and attacked Tong Youyou. With the handle being seized, the Xu family seemed to be protecting the girl to death. At this moment, she did not dare to take action easily, so she could only endure it for now and make plans later.
She kept planning in her mind, and it was already midnight when she finally fell asleep.
It seemed that not long after I closed my eyes, a woman who was personally serving me stepped forward to report——
"Madam, it's time to get up. The eldest lady should go to the girls' school. I'll be here to say hello in a moment. "
Mrs. Tong endured the throbbing pain in her temples, stood up with a dark face, scolded the maid who was bringing the water, and then she felt a little calmer in her heart.
Chapter 13: Give her all the property (1)
Soon, Tong Qianqian came to say hello, and the mother and daughter sat down to eat together.
Mrs. Tong looked at her daughter who had changed into a plain dress, with only a silver hairpin on her head. She felt that her daughter was sensible, so she couldn't help but smile. Just as she was about to praise her daughter, a second-class woman came to repay her——
"Madam, Mrs. Xu is here again, bringing several carriages and many people. "
"What? "Mrs. Tong frowned, a little annoyed, "What kind of delusion did the Xu family get fed by that dead girl? They just came to the door with great fanfare yesterday, and they came again today. Are they still afraid that I might eat that dead girl? "
She cursed, but she didn't dare not to accept him, so she hurriedly packed up and rushed to the second door.
Tong Qianqian was curious and followed behind to see what was going on, regardless of going to school.
Soon, the Xu family's carriage entered the Tong family gate and stopped in front of the second gate. But there were too many carriages, only five came in, and another five were outside the gate.
Mrs. Xu got off the carriage, accompanied by a seven or eight-year-old girl. Their clothes and jewelry were not gorgeous, after all, the Tong family was still in the period of mourning, but the righteousness and dignity in their eyebrows always told everyone that the Xu family, as the family of the imperial censor, had an upright family tradition. Not to mention a fifth-grade doctor, even a first-grade official should not look down upon him.
The servants of the Tong family lowered their heads and were very humble.
Mrs. Tong quickly raised her smile and came forward to say hello, "Oh, Sister Wang, why are you here? But what did we do poorly yesterday? "
Mrs. Xu smiled lightly and returned the greeting: "My sister is known to be kind-hearted and understanding of etiquette, so how could she be so imprudent? It's just that my old sister-in-law was worried that her daughter, Youyou, had just returned home, and was afraid that Youyou wouldn't get used to living there. In addition, my little girl also missed her sister Youyou and wanted me to come over earlier. I had no choice but to bring all the things that Youyou had at home these past few days, and also added some small things. hopeDon't get me wrong, sister, although you are a stepmother, you will definitely treat Youyou well. We are just worrying randomly. "
"Don't dare, don't dare. It's also a blessing for Youyou that Sister Wang and First Lady love us so much. "Mrs. Tong kept cursing in her heart, but she still spoke politely on the surface.
"Okay, sister, let's have people move things to Youyou's yard. I made a list of all these things, and gave one to Youyou later. I also kept a copy here, so I wouldn’t worry about the slaves messing it up or losing it. "
